::: {.callout-warning}
## Registration is not yet open

The current meeting's registration form, deadlines, attendance cap, and venue
details still need to be confirmed. The information below describes the 2025
meeting and is retained as a planning reference.
:::

## Who can attend?

SoCal BOOM brings together students, postdoctoral researchers, researchers,
and faculty from across Southern California who are interested in global and
regional marine biogeochemistry. Undergraduates and other members of the
research community are also welcome to attend.

## Registration and deadlines

The 2025 meeting used a single Google form for attendance registration and
abstract submission. Talk abstracts had an advance deadline, while poster
submissions and attendance registration remained open until the meeting
reached its 120-person capacity.

Current registration and abstract deadlines will be added here when they are
available. Questions can be directed through the [Contact Us](contact.qmd)
page.

Planning to give a talk or poster? See [For Presenters](scientific-program/for-presenters.qmd)
for presentation formats and practical guidance.

*[Source: 2025 registration and abstract submission information](https://socalboom.wordpress.com/home/registration-and-abstract-submission/).*
